name: Udmurtia (Udmurt SSR, 1990–1993)
description: A red field with a blue vertical stripe at the hoist, a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a yellow-bordered red star in the upper hoist, and the inscription 'Удмуртская ССР / Удмурт ССР' in Russian and Udmurt in yellow.
history: The RSFSR-pattern flag of the Udmurt ASSR with the inscription changed after the sovereignty declaration of September 1990. It was replaced on 4 November 1993 by the black, white and red flag with the solar sign.

features.role: inscription 'Удмуртская ССР / Удмурт ССР' in Russian and Udmurt
